description.en: The AppName of the live stream.
The number of entries per page. Default value: **10**. Valid values: **5 to 100**.

title.zh: 查询直播录制转点播配置

descriptions.zh:
先获取播流域名，再调用本接口查询直播转点播配置列表。


## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为1000次/分钟。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
### **QPS limit**

This API is limited to 1,000 queries per minute for each account. If you exceed this limit, API calls are throttled, which can affect your business.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live describe-live-record-vod-configs --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --app-name liveApp0000 --stream-name liveStream0000 --page-num 1 --page-size 10 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live DescribeLiveRecordVodConfigs --region cn-hangzhou --StreamName liveStream0000 --PageNum 1 --PageSize 10 --DomainName 'example.com' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --AppName liveApp0000
